# Variable `TARGET_LD_ARCH`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

Specifies architecture-specific linker flags for the target system. TARGET_LD_ARCH is initialized from TUNE_LDARGS by default in the BitBake configuration file (`meta/conf/bitbake.conf`):

```
TARGET_LD_ARCH = "${TUNE_LDARGS}"

```

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-TARGET_LD_ARCH)
